stem: How does the author of “Car Talk” differ from Brandy in “Needed”?

options.label: F
options.text: The author of “Car Talk” wants to master a skill, while Brandy takes on a new responsibility.

options.label: G
options.text: The author of “Car Talk” thinks driving is scary, while Brandy thinks driving is fun.

options.label: H
options.text: The author of “Car Talk” is easily distracted, while Brandy pays attention when she drives.

options.label: J
options.text: The author of “Car Talk” does what she wants to do, while Brandy does what her father tells her to.
